knowledge_note: The scale is a fixed schedule written into the 2005 agreement, known from its ratification on July 30, 2005; it is not a later result. The FAQ's 2011-12 column is left out: the league opted out of the agreement before that season.

cap_treatment.rule: A 3+-year veteran's one-year minimum contract counts the 2-year minimum on team salary; the league reimburses the rest (cbafaq05 Q11).
